# Description list checks (Chrome DevTools MCP)

1. Open `/tests/fixtures/components/description-list/` on the Vite server. Run `await (await import('/tests/fixtures/components/description-list/api.ts')).verifyDescriptionLists()` through MCP evaluation. Expect 42 assertions. Repeat with `?package` after `npm run build`.
2. Click Show more in `#plot` with the real pointer: the three hidden items expand below Status (the viewport grows from the visible items' height to the full list), the values above do not move (sample `getBoundingClientRect` per frame), the button reads Show less and its chevron points up; focus stays on the button. Click again: the items collapse and the button reads Show more.
3. From the page start, press Tab: focus skips the hidden `Shared tap, row C` link and reaches Show more with the focus ring. Enter opens; Shift+Tab reaches the link; Tab back and Space closes with focus kept.
4. Navigate to `?r=1#:~:text=hive%20by%20the%20south` after the page has rendered (a same-document navigation): the `#found` list (`hidden-until-found`) opens and highlights the match.
5. Inspect the accessibility tree: each list is one description list with term/definition pairs; hidden items are absent while closed; Show more is a button with `expanded` false/true; the viewport has no role or name. Inject `/node_modules/axe-core/axe.min.js` and run `axe.run(document.querySelector('main'))` closed and open: no violations in the light theme (the dark success Badge pair is a known token contrast gap).
6. Inspect light and dark themes, `dir="rtl"` on a list (labels at the inline start on the right), a 400px viewport, the page minimum width, with body margin 0 (long labels and values wrap, the label column stays within 40%, no horizontal overflow) and `#stacked` (labels above values).
